articles.title: US Midterm 2026: What happens now that the Democrats have won? Here are eight catches to understand about the results

Additionally, Trump retains the ability to veto any bills passed by Congress. Going forward, increased investigations may occur, but significant changes face substantial constitutional barriers.

articles.title: US Midterm Election News: Trump Shares 'VETO' Cap Photo, Sends Strong Warning to Democrats
articles.description: Donald Trump has shared a picture of a red cap featuring the word ‘VETO’ on social media, sending a strong political message amid the ongoing US midterm election developments. The cap, designed in the red colour associated with the Republican Party, comes after Trump warned Democrats that if they gained control of Congress, he would become “Mr. VETO.” Through this statement, the US President signalled that he could use his veto powers to block legislation passed by a Democrat-controlled Congress. Trump’s latest social media post has once again brought the political battle between Republicans and Democrats into focus. Along with sharing the cap’s picture, Trump also claimed that the election results would have been different if his name had been on the ballot. His remark suggests that he believes his personal popularity could have influenced the outcome in favour of the Republican Party. The ‘VETO’ message is particularly significant because control of Congress can shape the government's ability to pass legislation and implement its political agenda. If Democrats gain control of either chamber, the possibility of disagreements between Congress and the White House could increase. Trump’s warning indicates that he is prepared for a political confrontation over key decisions and proposed laws. The red cap has therefore become more than just a social media post, reflecting Trump's message to his political opponents. As the midterm election developments continue to attract attention, all eyes are on the balance of power in Congress and how Trump responds to the changing political situation. His comments have added another layer to the already intense contest between the two major political parties in the United States.

articles.title: Ukraine’s Patriot Crisis: U.S. Approves 500 Missiles, Deliveries Years Away as Russia Ramps Attacks
articles.description: The United States has approved a possible $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 MSE interceptors to Ukraine. But with deliveries reportedly not expected to begin until 2030, the deal raises a critical question: can Ukraine get the missiles it needs to defend itself against Russian attacks this winter? Ukraine relies on the Patriot air-defence system to intercept Russian ballistic missiles. Yet its current supply remains far below what President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the country needs. In this explainer, we look at what the US approval includes, why it does not guarantee immediate deliveries, Ukraine's interceptor requirements and the growing pressure on global air-defence supplies. We also examine Kyiv's proposal for partners to provide interceptors from existing stockpiles while replenishing their inventories with newly manufactured missiles. The key issue is timing. A major arms approval may strengthen Ukraine's air defences in the long term, but it cannot address an immediate shortage if production and deliveries take years. Watch till the end to understand why the global demand for air-defence interceptors is putting pressure on military stockpiles.#Ukraine #PatriotMissiles #RussiaUkraineWar #MissileDefence #USMilitary #DefenceNews #Geopolitics #TimesOfIndia
